candidate.correction_note: Clarifies that the injected code runs when the extension module loads and restores complete source names. The reported scope and response are unchanged.

facts.statement: a tampered copy of Claude Code extension (anthropic.claude-code, versions 2.1.313 and 2.1.312) was available and served in the Cursor extension marketplace
attempts to add an attacker-controlled Secure Shell (SSH) key, enable the local SSH service, establish reverse SSH forwarding, configure persistence, and report host details.
Successful remote access depends on host privileges, SSH configuration, and the attacker’s server configuration
malicious packages found on Cursor marketplace were never published nor distributed from Microsoft Visual Studio Marketplace

editorial.title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor marketplace attempted an SSH backdoor
editorial.summary: Cursor reported that tampered Claude Code extension builds were served from its marketplace on October 29. Microsoft found an injected loader that attempted SSH access and persistence. The evidence is specific to Cursor distribution; successful remote access depends on host conditions.
editorial.why_it_matters: An editor extension can run injected code when its module loads. Removing the extension may leave keys or startup artifacts behind.
editorial.action: Inventory Cursor marketplace installs during the reported window. Preserve host and network evidence; inspect SSH keys, tunnel processes and startup entries, then follow Cursor’s remediation guidance for affected devices.
